issue.title: Bug: sonic-installer get-fips/set-fips not working on systems in UEFI mode

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Critical

### Description of the bug

Executing this command throws an error:

```
admin@sonic:~$ sudo sonic-installer get-fips
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/usr/local/bin/sonic-installer", line 8, in <module>
    sys.exit(sonic_installer())
             ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.11/dist-packages/click/core.py", line 764, in __call__
    return self.main(*args, **kwargs)
           ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.11/dist-packages/click/core.py", line 717, in main
    rv = self.invoke(ctx)
         ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.11/dist-packages/click/core.py", line 1137, in invoke
    return _process_result(sub_ctx.command.invoke(sub_ctx))
                           ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.11/dist-packages/click/core.py", line 956, in invoke
    return ctx.invoke(self.callback, **ctx.params)
           ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.11/dist-packages/click/core.py", line 555, in invoke
    return callback(*args, **kwargs)
           ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.11/dist-packages/sonic_installer/main.py", line 691, in get_fips
    enable = bootloader.get_fips(image)
             ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.11/dist-packages/sonic_installer/bootloader/grub.py", line 125, in get_fips
    return 'sonic_fips=1' in cmdline
           ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
TypeError: argument of type 'NoneType' is not iterable
```

The parsing of the grub.cfg fails because instead of ```linux``` command it has ```linuxefi``` in ```menuentry```.
Content of ```/host/grub/grub.cfg```:
```
menuentry 'SONiC-OS-202412_RC.151-550a6c0b8_Internal' {
        search --no-floppy --label --set=root SONiC-OS
        echo    'Loading SONiC-OS OS kernel ...'
        insmod gzio
        if [ x = xxen ]; then insmod xzio; insmod lzopio; fi
        insmod part_msdos
        insmod ext2
        linuxefi   /image-202412_RC.151-550a6c0b8_Internal/boot/vmlinuz-6.1.0-29-2-amd64 root=UUID=66660f45-73df-4968-b910-4d418f595d8a rw console=tty0 console=ttyS0,115200n8 quiet processor.max_cstate=1 intel_idle.max_cstate=0 sonic_fips=1                  net.ifnames=0 biosdevname=0                 loop=image-202412_RC.151-550a6c0b8_Internal/fs.squashfs loopfstype=squashfs                                       systemd.unified_cgroup_hierarchy=0                 apparmor=1 security=apparmor varlog_size=4096 usbcore.autosuspend=-1 libata.force=noncq tpm_tis.interrupts=0 nosgx
        echo    'Loading SONiC-OS OS initial ramdisk ...'
        initrdefi  /image-202412_RC.151-550a6c0b8_Internal/boot/initrd.img-6.1.0-29-2-amd64
}
```

When the code expects the line to start with ```linux```:

https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-utilities/blob/master/sonic_installer/bootloader/grub.py#L88-L99

### Steps to Reproduce

Execute commands:
```
admin@sonic:~$ sudo sonic-installer get-fips
```

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

get-fips returns FIPS enable status
set-fips enabled or disables FIPS
